**Obligations of the Client (המזמין):**
- Pay the consideration within 45 days from receiving a lawful tax invoice (L3, L13, L33, L43).
- May inspect the quality of service at any time, subject to prior coordination (L10, L20, L30, L40).

**Obligations of the Supplier (הספק):**
- Maintain a stock of available spare parts for the factory service in Kiryat Gat (L4, L14, L24).
- Any change in the scope of service must be made in writing and signed by both parties (L5, L15, L25, L35, L45).
- Supplier's technician shall arrive at the warehouse in Ashdod within four hours for an urgent call, and within two days for a regular call (L6, L16, L26, L36, L46).
- Both parties shall keep secret any information received within the framework of the engagement (L8, L38).
- Coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the Kiryat Gat factory that requires a shutdown (L7, L9, L17, L19, L27, L29).
- Appoint one customer manager to coordinate relations with the client (L9, L11, L19, L21, L29, L31, L39, L41).
- Insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party insurance (L17, L25, L27, L35, L37, L45, L47).
- Perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a report on the visit (L20, L22, L30, L32, L40, L42).

**Fines (Cases and Amounts):**
- Delay in responding to an urgent service call at the logistics center in Holon: 1,000 NIS per case (L7).
- Failure to meet repair times specified in the service appendix at the offices in Tel Aviv: 2,750 NIS per case (L12).
- Shutdown of the cooling system for more than four hours at the Kiryat Gat factory: 4,500 NIS per case (L18).
- Failure to submit a monthly maintenance report on time at the Haifa branch: 6,250 NIS per case (L23).
- Replacement of a technician without prior notice at the Ashdod warehouse: 8,000 NIS per case (L28).
- Use of non-original spare parts at the logistics center in Holon: 9,750 NIS per case (L34).
- Breach of safety instructions on-site at the Tel Aviv offices: 11,500 NIS per case (L39).
- Loss of client equipment at the Kiryat Gat factory: 13,250 NIS per case (L44).
